objective: First source-faithful C1L1 Stark Expo playable mission, on real Vita

policy.do_not_expand_until_first_slice: Defer other missions, additional armors, co-op, secondary combat and extra assets until this slice passes device tests.
policy.test_vpk_policy: No automatic candidate VPK merely because ELF CI passes; request one deliberate hardware test when an integrated build has measurable purpose.

criteria.name: Floor, buildings, wall and ceiling player capsule
criteria.source_evidence: G134 sweep limits per-step teleport; G108 supplemental original opaque visual candidates; G156 source-mode exact continuous vertical cylinder contact removes a verified geometric three-Z-sample miss (C11 host SUCCESS, full ARM/retest tracked separately). Source 1910 native faces are not a proof that every visible building is solid.
